scope: PlanarSrf stored-seam parity, coplanar source isolation, whole-loop hole admission, observed duplicate encodings, native per-region construction and coincident polygon-hole meshing.

comparisons.region_identity: Original source membership of each outer/inner loop, preserving loop and output multiplicity; output and inner-loop ordering canonicalized.
comparisons.sources: Complete source NURBS definitions at absolute epsilon 1e-12 in the public OpenNURBS coefficient chart (x*w)*(1.0/w); retained Rust source objects also checked for exact equality.
comparisons.membership: Bidirectional spatial witnesses at 1e-7: native 33 stations per curve with checked closest-point refinement; Rust 33 source and 17 edge stations, or exact single-edge equality.
comparisons.archive: Persistent output UUID lookup, boundary membership, area and normal-mesh generation before and after 3DM serialization.
comparisons.policies: Local checks cover DeleteInput, all duplicate source consumption, attributes, layers, groups, selection, one Undo/Redo step and atomic 129-boundary budget failure.
comparisons.excluded: Complete used native B-rep definitions are retained in raw captures but excluded from the region comparison, along with output bounds, diagnostic Contains matrix, command text/events and native validity metadata. Capture tests independently check native success, command events and source/history preservation.

headless.native_captures: Private Xvfb/i3 and private XDG_RUNTIME_DIR through tools/rhino_oracle/run_headless.sh; Wayland and compositor sockets unset; only owned Rhino closed.
headless.application_tests: test_app state with DISPLAY, WAYLAND_DISPLAY, WAYLAND_SOCKET, SWAYSOCK and I3SOCK removed; no GUI event loop.

limits: Region identity and model area are qualified on the recorded cases, not complete B-rep parameterization, output/loop birth order or general shape parity.
The 109 application/archive cases include four repeated source scenes; 105 ordered source definitions are distinct across the full capture corpus.
The transforms capture preserves one unsuccessful large-circle source matcher result. Confirmations repeat all 32 scenes with refined witnesses and exactly unchanged native B-rep definitions.
Coincident polygon loops retain native model-area multiplicity while triangulation represents one geometric hole. Boundary audit sharing is limited to complete identical same-face degree-one paths.
Continuous contact completeness, crossing trim configurations, arbitrary self-intersections, near-tolerance plane grouping and further coincident curve encodings remain unqualified.
Open chains are skipped rather than joined; the command accepts at most 128 closed planar boundaries.
PlanarMesh retains its independent-contact policy; all 21 geometry outcomes and the existing 11 topology gaps remain unchanged in its refreshed report.
